title: Groups
body:
## Human

Humans are humans. They can live in New Bergen or on Starlight. Due to the technical and medicinal advancements over the years, humans can live longer and are overall healthier. They still are not invincible or necessarily stronger or faster than our modern counterpart. Human limitations still affect them. Unfortunately, living longer also means having to work for much longer before retirement.

_**Naming conventions:** Mostly normal earth names. Scandinavian/nordic, hispanic, latino and american influences. Lunarites might have changed names for various reasons when they arrived on the moon._

## Lunarborn

The first Lunar generation, born on Luna in Starlight, is coming to age now. They are all between ages _20-27._ Due to them being born and having grown up in Starlight, they are the first humans to have grown up in low gravity. This causes them to usually be taller than humans on average, they also tend to be paler. Some Lunarborn might not have ever been Earthside, or have only been there once or twice during their lifetime. Everyone in the first Lunar Generation were carefully monitored by SAGE and Stromberg and have been going through weight training called "loading" in order to develop naturally. They also all have a free elevator pass they can use monthly (no passengers included) as a perk of being Lunarborn.

_**Naming conventions:** Futuristic, alien or foreign names._

## BIOSYNT-7B

The 7B model is the most advanced android ever created. A constant topic of humanity, rights and consciousness surrounds the 7B due to it having an actual, functioning brain in them. Grown by Biotechnica, the brain is a fully adult brain that is capable of learning, emotions and preferences. The inhibitor chip makes them obedient and inhibits functions that would go against it's product agreement. Despite their brains, they are still considered a product that is bought and owned by people who can afford them. During the past several years, there's been protests and movements both for and against the 7B. Chop shops exist to take them apart and sell their parts, criminal groups traffic them, and some benevolent engineers have found out a way to liberate them. They are not recognized as people and have no rights. They can not take loans or buy property as an example. Every individual 7B have their own opinions and concerns regarding this. Some don't care, some do. Some love their work and owner, other doesn't.

_**Naming conventions:** Named  by their owner. Due to their consciousness, they might have naming preferences and want to name themselves eventually._

## Engineer

When newer and newer generations had fewer and fewer children, Stromberg stepped in with a solution to human reproduction. Engineers became one such answer. Engineers are not born in the traditional sense, but rather created and cultivated from what is called a "seed": a collection of constructed genomes capable of producing unique human beings without biological parents. Despite their artificial origins, Engineers are entirely human. They have human brains, organs and biology, and unlike synthetic models such as the 7B, their personality, interests and preferences cannot be selected or programmed. Certain physical traits can be chosen, while many known hereditary conditions can be avoided.

There are many reasons for creating an Engineer. Some are raised by parents who could not have children themselves or simply chose not to pass on their own genetics. Others have been created as compatible organ donors for wealthy clients, commissioned by Stromberg in response to population needs, or raised within Stromberg facilities for research. Some can even be cultivated to a young childhood age before joining a family. As a result, Engineers can have anything from completely ordinary and loving childhoods to deeply unconventional ones.

Engineers have no biological mother or father. While their seed ultimately draws from human genetic material, there is no individual person they can point to as a biological parent. Legally they are people with the same rights as any other human, but their existence continues to raise questions about parenthood, reproduction and how much control anyone should have over the person they bring into the world. Engineers themselves have no universal opinion on their origins. Some are proud of what they are, some consider their seed little more than medical trivia, while others resent the choices made about them before they ever existed.

**Naming conventions:** _Open._

---
## Wiccan

Although not part of a religious belief, Wiccans is the common name in New Bergen for humans with what is considered the _sight_ or _intuition._ Whether it's sensing others aura or getting premonitions, they mainly use _tarot_ and _crystals_. Some people believe them heavily and uses their "gift" to get a hint of the future, while others are skeptical. Biotechnica in particular is vocally against the phenomenon. Whether it comes from the water, radiation or something else is unknown. Wiccans can live in Starlight or in New Bergen. 

## Monk

There's a subset of people who reject the modern technologies and medicine that unnaturally extends us as humans. They don't reject technology such as phones or transits, just medicine that is synthetic or extends human life far beyond what they consider it should be. It's a moral and/or philosophical belief. They are not monks by any sort of religion, although they can be, but the common folk usually refers to them as _monks_ or _nattys_.
